title: 地底空洞ステーション：岩盤と建築
theme: a scientific research outpost built inside a vast natural underground cavern, gritty realistic industrial style

cells.name: 空洞の玄武岩
cells.prompt: dark wet basalt cave rock wall, fractured columnar joints, damp sheen, grey-black with faint brown mineral staining, about 3 m across

cells.name: 砕石の床
cells.prompt: compacted crushed-rock gravel cave floor seen from directly above, mixed grey and ochre stones 1-4 cm, packed dust between them, about 2 m across

cells.name: 吹付けコンクリート
cells.prompt: sprayed shotcrete tunnel lining, lumpy grey concrete with rough aggregate texture and faint damp streaks, about 3 m across

cells.name: 波板の外壁
cells.prompt: vertical corrugated steel cladding panels painted off-white, light grime and a few rust spots, corrugations running top to bottom, about 2 m across

cells.name: 金属屋根
cells.prompt: dark graphite standing-seam metal roofing, straight raised seams running top to bottom every 40 cm, subtle dust and water marks, about 2 m across

cells.name: 打放しの基礎
cells.prompt: smooth cast-in-place concrete slab with formwork panel joints in a regular grid and small round tie holes, light grey, about 2 m across

cells.name: 耐候性鋼板
cells.prompt: weathering corten steel plate, deep orange-brown rust patina with darker streaks and pitting, about 1.5 m across

cells.name: 床グレーチング
cells.prompt: galvanized steel bar grating walkway seen from directly above, parallel load bars with twisted cross rods, silver-grey metal over a black void, about 1 m across

cells.name: 警告ストライプ
cells.prompt: worn yellow and black diagonal hazard stripes painted on steel, scuffed and chipped paint, stripes at 45 degrees, about 1 m across
